title: PHP Conference Ehime 2026
content:
PHP Conference Ehime will be held for the first time on October 3, 2026 (JST), at Ehime University Johoku Campus in Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture, Japan.🍊

The theme of the conference is "技術愛とコミュニティ愛と愛媛愛と": love for technology, love for the community, and love for Ehime.

Join us in this castle and hot-spring town of Shikoku, and connect with PHP developers from all over Japan.
